title: picea glauca var. albertiana
intro: Picea glauca var. albertiana, commonly known as Alberta spruce, is a variant of the white spruce tree native to North America. This evergreen conifer is valued for its essential oil, which is used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Picea glauca var. albertiana essential oil include pain relief, reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this oil include alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
